notes.title: The Last Universe ! [Gangs of Space Closing]
notes.content:
Gangs of Space was our child and became the prison of our hopes. Gangs of Space was a stroke of madness that arrived one day, or maybe a night, in Tokyo in the middle of an amusement arcade full of Shmup classics! Gangs of Space it was quite an adventure!

You have understood, it is with great regret that [b]we announce today the upcoming closure of Gangs of Space.[/b]

[h1][b]Closing schedule[/b][/h1]

[list][*][b]November 30, 2018:[/b] commercial closure (end of the sale of the DLC).[/*][*][b]May 31, 2019:[/b] official servers and support closed.[/*][/list]
And after ? Total blackout? We will see, but we can not guarantee anything and in any case, it will be outside of Steam.

[h1][b]Why do we close?[/b][/h1]

Maybe one day Erhune will have the courage to do a long post-mortem on the dev and the reasons for the end of Gangs of Space, but by then we will try to give you the main reasons:
[list][*][b]No money![/b] After all these years of work on Gangs of Space, the launch in Early Access and the reception of tens of thousands of players, we have never been able to pay us, not even a beer or a restaurant … nothing at all! We had made the choice to reinvest everything to self-finance the dev of the game (software, assets, hosting / server, freelance, administration, etc …). How did we manage to stay that long without going crazy? Maybe we already were ?![/*][*][b]No founding![/b] But as it was not enough, we tried to find investors to finish GoS in V1, but even with a well advanced game and 70,000 players it was too risky for them.[/*][*][b]No communication![/b] It’s simple, in 2018 (and also in 2017), to talk about your game in the media, the norm is that you have to pay or that everyone is already talking about you … Totally despairing when you still want to make “different” games that nobody wants to finance.[/*][/list]
[b]No more energy![/b] In the end, all this consumed our ultimate energy reserves. We will have tried many things (probably not as good as those who will give us advice) but now it was time to move on.

[h1][b]Commercial closure?[/b][/h1]

Because we do not want to sell a service that you do not really have time to use at your convenience, we prefer to close the purchase of DLC after this announcement.

This allows us to provide another 6 months of service for the last irreducible who would still like to enjoy a DLC Gangs of Space.

And we promise you, this time “the money of subscribers” who will take a DLC will only serve one thing: [b]to pay us a beer and a good restaurant![/b]

[h1][b]Thanks[/b][/h1]

After all these years we met many people without whom this project could not have gone so far and we wish to thank:b
[list][*]First of all, thank you [b]to the family![/b] These relatives who have supported us all these years without understanding our determination to finish GoS. With them no judgment, no advice, but listening, love, and the good dishes of our mothers who comfort so much in times of doubt.[/*][*]Right after, there is [b]YOU, you the 70,000 players![/b] From a few minutes to a few years, you played and participated with determination! Your feedback has been decisive in the evolution of the game. To have made a game that will have you passionate, amused, relaxed, raging, will be our greatest pride forever. [b]Thank you 70,000 times![/b][list][*]And thanks to those [b]active members of the community[/b] who are especially involved at all levels, wiki, moderation, community pillars, passionate evening streamers, etc … (no names for no jealous, but you will recognize ;-D)[/*][/list][/*][*][b]-oTo-[/b], our composer who has held all these years and whose work we loved.[/*][*]Thanks to [b]Aganon, Skywilly, Bestio and Seldell[/b], from the websites  [url=https://www.jeuxonline.info/]Jeuxonline[/url], [url=https://www.gamesidestory.com/]Game Side Story[/url] et [url=https://www.indiemag.fr/]Indiemag[/url]. If the journalists and the Streamers were all like them, there is no doubt that you will not play at all the same way and many creators would have a greater chance to live from their work and offer you original games![/*][*]Thanks to the [b]creators of Unity[/b], the transition from Flash to this software has really changed our life and allowed a gigantic qualitative leap for GoS.[/*][*]And finally thank you to [b]all the devs, friends, some streamers, visitors on a show, star[/b] (like [b]Richard Garriot[/b] or [b]Zun[/b]) who have some day participated in their advice, their help, to make Gangs of Space.[/*][/list]

[h1][b]Come and sign the big guestbook![/b][/h1]

The closing of an MMO is always a special moment, it is the opportunity for the old players to nostalgically recall their best memories. For the occasion, two “Golden Books” are open on our official forum where you are invited to come and tell what GoS was for you, your memories, your anecdotes, even a screenshot?
[list][*][b][url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/t/guest-book-of-gangs-of-space/1397]Guestbook Gangs of Space [english][/url][/b][/*][*][url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/t/livre-dor-de-gangs-of-space/1396]Guestbook Gangs of Space [french][/url][/*][/list]

[h1][b]MINI FAQ[/b][/h1]

[b]Why is the game not open source?[/b]
[list][*]This is a good question and we have studied the possibility but it is a big job. There are more legal reasons because we would not have the right to open some code blocks. In short, it is very complex.[/*][/list]
[b]Why was the game not sold? Users have value no?[/b]
[list][*]An MMO that is not finished is very complicated to sell, it’s not like a solo game. It will be necessary to put hands in the code, take care of the servers, etc. So unless you have a huge community or a big marketing buzz around the project, nobody wants to get wet.[/*][/list]
[b]All hope is lost forever?[/b]
[list][*]It is almost certain that neither Erhune nor Grouroux will ever work on Gangs of Space again. On the other hand if one day a serious team wishes to work on Gangs of Space and shows us that it has the capacity, one will study it with the greatest care.[/*][/list]

notes.title: 8 new Skins to collect
notes.content:
With the start of the Sixo Vaporis galaxy, we have added 8 new skins. All these skins are linked to special codes that you can activate in your [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/en/account]account management area[/url]. The Skin code hunt is open!

[img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/0/0edae74270dd8a1cb69c431a062f6463b02d71dc.jpg[/img]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/322750/Drifting_Lands/][b]Drifting Lands[/b][/url] is a [b]SHMUP Hack’n Slash[/b] graphically superb and with very interesting game mechanics (the auto-warp is inspired by one of their system). [img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/f/f272ddbf68e9380275f52e69108da088207c69da.jpg[/img]

[b]How to get this skin:[/b] I have heard that there will be code available in the Steam forums of the game…

[url=https://twitter.com/monsieursapin_][b]monsieursapin[/b][/url] is a very nice french Streamer who loves to discover games in all styles to his joyful community. [url=https://twitter.com/Bestio_][b]Bestio[/b][/url] is THE streamer of Shmup in France. Big fan of bullets and Hack’n Slash, he fell very early on Gangs of Space and followed us all these years. This skin is like a big thank you to him for his passion of games!

notes.title: Death to the permadeath
notes.content:
[h1]Death to the permadeath![/h1]

[i]Gangs of Space[/i] has been designed from the beginning to be a permadeath game (even before we introduced the “roguelite” elements like subsystems; our inspiration is taken mostly from old arcade games).

Even though we - and many players - like it this way, it is true that losing a ship can be a demoralizing experience for a new player. So today, we’re introducing a [b]permadeath protection[/b] designed to help beginners without changing the fundamental high-level game for experienced players.

From now on, [b]newly built ships[/b] will be equipped by default with a new passive item: the [b][i]Auto-Warp[/i][/b]. This item warps you back automatically to the Motherbase when you would have taken a fatal hit, but it comes with a few drawbacks:
[list]
[*]since it is a passive item, you cannot equip another item that would have given you nice passive bonuses;[/*]
[*]it lowers all Sector Points (SP) and Credit gains by 25%;[/*]
[*]it prevents you from warping to T5 or T6 systems.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/f/f880b9c1f11cd497ff13bdaca4c86e10d474e8e7.png[/img]

You can remove this item at any time (and we encourage experienced players to do so!), but it will be destroyed in the process.

[img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/5/5c601129d589bad5daf39f589ce82e53851ed6a9.png[/img]

[h1]New base skins[/h1]

To add some visual variety, all ships are now created [b]randomly with one out of 3 base colors[/b].

[img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/4/4d74d7a05e028ea7ea1e0b1874b242ba8b180f83.png[/img]

Of course you can still customize your ship at any time (for free) in the [i]Skin Shop[/i].

[h1]10 new music tracks![/h1]

Alex, the composer of the soundtrack of [i]Gangs of Space[/i], has been touched by all your positive feedback about his compositions. So he has graced us with 10 more tracks, which triples the amount of music we now have in the game!

You can discover these new tracks everywhere, from an alternative Motherbase ambiance to different music for all 6 tiers, and even some music on the death screen! (another good reason to un-equip your [i]Auto-Warp[/i]!)

[h1]Patch 0.31.11[/h1]

As usual, all the details of the patch are available [url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/t/changelog/198/34]in the changelog[/url].

[h1]A wiki full of treasures[/h1]

Thanks to [url=https://wiki.gangsofspace.com/Special:ActiveUsers]a growing team of motivated players[/url], the [i]Gangs of Space[/i] Wiki is now full of useful information:

[b][url=https://wiki.gangsofspace.com/]wiki.gangsofspace.com[/url][/b]

Items, ships, subsystems, drops, enemies… all there, ready for your eyes!

There is still a lot of translation work though, so if you speak another language like Spanish, Russian, Chinese, German, Portuguese… then join the Wiki team on Discord! You will be more than welcome!

[h1]A new Conquest: Cinquo Vaporis Galaxy[/h1]

The Empire has started the construction of a new Motherbase in Cinquo Vaporis Galaxy. Enemy forces have been evaluted to about 17,000,000. Get ready for the cleaning, and maybe the Empire will reward the most valorous of you!

[h1]Summary of the previous Conquest[/h1]

[b]Shark Investor Pack[/b]
The Imperial Bank has computed dividends for the conquest of [i]Quatro Vaporis Galaxy[/i]. Each Share will be awarded dividends of 168 Credits, for a total of [b]8,400 Credits for the 50 Shares of the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/]Shark Investor Pack[/url][/b].

[b]Ladders[/b]
Congratulations to all players that exterminated the Pirnat faction in  1 week, 12 hours, 18 minutes, and 7 seconds.

The players and Gangs that will receive Imperial awards for this Conquest are:
[url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/7/7b3292bb2d70fdb5c4a83fbd6ebb4c783e8f5da5.png][img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/2X/7/7b3292bb2d70fdb5c4a83fbd6ebb4c783e8f5da5_1_690x281.png[/img][/url]

[b]Souvenir[/b]
A last glimpse of [i]Quatro Vaporis Galaxy[/i] accompanied by a group picture of the winning Gang:

[url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/6/6c0c38c8c70adc14f40dcd7fcb82989c071bfe38.png][img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/2X/6/6c0c38c8c70adc14f40dcd7fcb82989c071bfe38_1_690x421.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/c/ce6e2a8f5caf847fe3b2f4985f645bf2caba3d01.png][img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/2X/c/ce6e2a8f5caf847fe3b2f4985f645bf2caba3d01_1_682x800.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: END OF THIRD CONQUEST
notes.content:
[img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/2X/3/30e7c6832672eb68b8d4fddd93718de6b7442fa2_1_690x281.png[/img]

[b]Galaxy Tertio Vaporis[/b] has been conquered in [b]10 days, 11 hours, 1 minute et 6 seconds[/b]!

On the ladder side:

[list]
[*][b]DJOKKATAJA[/b] wins the [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/en/galaxy/tertio-vaporis/grind]TOP GRIND[/url] with a very impressive score of 1,174,894 SP. A new record! But [b]Zed[/b] is just behind… on purpose, maybe?[/*]
[*]Because on the [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/en/galaxy/tertio-vaporis/skill]TOP SKILL[/url] side, [b]Zed[/b] improves his previous best score, and reaches almost 33K SP/h! [b]Jhirin[/b] and [b]kragnir[/b] beat their previous records too, but it wasn’t enough this time.[/*]
[*]On the [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/en/galaxy/tertio-vaporis/gangs]TOP GANG[/url], [b]8-bit Warriors[/b] get their first victory, pushed by their leader and their very active members. They almost reach the previous record set by [b]Meta[/b] in the previous Galaxy![/*]
[/list]

[h1]SUMMARY[/h1]

During this Conquest, [b]we have banned 15 accounts for cheating[/b]. We remind everyone that modifying the game client or the game memory is forbidden by our Terms of Service. It is a question of common sense: let’s keep a pleasant environment for everyone to play and compete in!

The [url=http://wiki.gangsofspace.com]wiki.gangsofspace.com[/url] grows bigger and bigger, with new info coming every day, and translations in French and Russian starting to pop in. If you can write decent Chinese, Polish, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Japanese, or any other language spoken by a part of the [u]Gangs of Space[/u] community, why not contribute to the effort?

On the Steam side, we celebrate today our 1 month release anniversary! With 10 versions published during this period, almost one every 3 days! On your side, you’ve left [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/504300/Gangs_of_Space/#app_reviews_hash]216 evaluations, 78% positive[/url]. [b]Thanks a lot![/b]

[h1]RECENT PATCHES[/h1]

We are pushing a lot of small updates these days, of course to fix problems that have been reported to you, but also to improve the way we convey information in the game. We’re very happy to see that the community has stepped in to help newbies understand the game better, but we need to do our part, and make the game more easily understood!

We have also worked a ton on “invisible” tasks in the background, including server optimization. If you haven’t tried v0.31.8, you’ll be surprised by how much pleasant the game is to play without all these pesky server lags that plagued us since the release!

Today, along with the new Conquest we are releasing v0.31.9 that revamps the ingame ladder interface, and a lot of quality-of-life improvements. Check out all the details in the [url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/t/changelog/198/32]changelog[/url]!

[h1]SHARK INVESTOR PACK[/h1]

How many dividends will our Shark Investors earn for the conquest of [u]Tertio Vaporis[/u]?

The latest data from the Imperial Bank shows that [b]each Share will receive a dividend of 312 Credits[/b], which means 15,600 Credits for the 50 Shares of the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/]Pack Shark Investor[/url].

[h1]SOUVENIR[/h1]

Thanks to [b]kragnir[/b] for remembering to take a end-of-galaxy souvenir picture, since we couldn’t be there on time to take one. Bye bye [u]Tertio Vaporis[/u]!

[/url]

[/*]

notes.title: End of the first conquest & patch v0.31.4
notes.content:
Congratulations to all players and all Gangs: [b]you conquered the Primor Vaporis Galaxy in 8 days, 7 hours, 36 minutes and 28 seconds![/b]

[h1]OVER THE TOP[/h1]

Let’s have a look at the final ladders:

[url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/1X/697df3950de60ac3bdd5bc2d907007a0d2b09cc2.png][img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/1X/697df3950de60ac3bdd5bc2d907007a0d2b09cc2_1_690x287.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]On the [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/en/ladder/primor-vaporis/grind]TOP GRIND[/url], we have a new Commander imposing his style: [b]Touch Me[/b] wins by a fair margin his title and his champion skin, with over 400,000 SP. Congratulations![/*]
[*]On the [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/en/ladder/primor-vaporis/gangs]TOP GANG[/url] ! [b]Esports[/b] get their first victory thank to a flawless teamwork. We say on the game Discord channel that this ladder was very fierce, and not only for the top 10 spots! Congratulations to everyone![/*]
[*]And finally, for the new [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/en/ladder/primor-vaporis/skill]TOP SKILL[/url], [b]Roix[/b] shows us that experience acquired over years of alpha versions still make him the top dog. With [b]a peak of over 25k SP/h[/b], he dominates the ladder by far.[/*]
[/list]


With this first conquest on Steam Early Access, many new players have joined the ranks of the Empire and are learning all the mechanics of the game very fast. Next Galaxy should turn out very competitive indeed!

[h1]STATE OF THE GAME[/h1]

It is for us a great emotion to see the servers so full of players all the time, for the first time of the existence of the game. From the bottom of our heart: THANK YOU! We’ve spent years working on this game, and seeing so many people enjoying it for real is giving us the energy to move forward with the game.


Speaking of moving forward, some words about our next steps.We are globally satisfied with the state of the game, but we have seen [b]how hard it is for many players to understand the game[/b], or some parts of it. We plan on putting a lot of efforts over the next weeks to improve the situation, and have already started to work on a FAQ here: [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/faq]https://www.gangsofspace.com/faq[/url]


The [url=https://discord.gg/JwTKNu5]Discord community[/url]  has also started to work on a wiki to give more details, with specific numbers for every aspect of the game. Join them if you want to help the effort!


Over the past week, we have been having [b]between 150 and 250 players online almost all the time[/b]. This makes the universe alive, with always something to do. We had to fix a few things on the server side to handle the load. This invisible effort continues every day, and will probably continue all over the duration of the Early Access. Thank you for bearing with the small bugs and slowdowns, and be assured that fixing that is always at high priority on our list.


On the Steam side, we’ve passed [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/504300/Gangs_of_Space/#app_reviews_hash][b]100+ evaluations[/b][/url] with [b]81% positive[/b]. Don’t hesitate to add your voice to the crowd, that’s how more players will know about [u]Gangs of Space[/u]!

[h1]PATCH 0.31.4[/h1]

We have deployed [b]v0.31.4[/b] along with the opening of the new Galaxy.


The main visible change of this version is the complete overhaul of Credit gains. We changed the Conquest rewards in v0.30 a few months ago, and we were a bit too conservative on the gains of the new system. Now that we have more data to back up our design, [b]we have increased the Credit rewards of conquest quite significantly[/b], especially in lower Tiers.


We also added a feature where [b]every time you unlock a new ship, you will gain the amount Credits necessary to build this ship[/b]. For example, when you unlock the [u]Gemeter DX[/u], you will now receive 10,000 Credits. [b]We have applied this retroactively to all already unlocked ships.[/b]


For more details, you can read the [url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/t/changelog/198/27]complete changelog[/url].

[h1]SHARE DIVIDENDS[/h1]

If you bought a [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/]Shark Investor Pack[/url], now is the time to figure out how many Credits your Shares have produced!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/

After a complex calculation by the Imperial Bank, we have determined that every Share will receive a dividend of 202 Credits.


But as a celebration of the first Conquest, and because the lowered Credit gains have impacted the amount of total Credits spent, we have decided to double this amount. You have thus received 404 Credits per Share, which means [b]20,200 Credits for a 50 Share Investor Pack[/b].


Stay tuned for the next Conquest. Hopefully, with the increase of Credit gains brought by the new patch, dividends might rise even further!

[h1]A MMO IS A COMMUNITY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE[/h1]

Join the [url=https://discord.gg/JwTKNu5]Discord[/url] or the [url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/]forum[/url]. We are answering all your questions, and listening to all your suggestions for the future of the game!

[h1]SOUVENIR[/h1]

A last memory of [u]Primor Vaporis[/u] before leaving for a new adventure:

[url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/1X/a8abbb9425140679c4e89020a4d9f403a8fa0826.jpg][img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/1X/a8abbb9425140679c4e89020a4d9f403a8fa0826_1_690x388.jpg[/img][/url]


[url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/1X/109e01d4c3fd9cc60eb097cccc030ec28e10fd31.jpg][img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/1X/109e01d4c3fd9cc60eb097cccc030ec28e10fd31_1_690x388.jpg[/img][/url]

We also added a feature where [b]every time you unlock a new ship, you will gain the amount Credits necessary to build this ship[/b]. For example, when you unlock the [u]Gemeter DX[/u], you will now receive 10,000 Credits. [b]We have applied this retroactively to all already unlocked ships.[/b]


For more details, you can read the [url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/t/changelog/198/27]complete changelog[/url].

[h1]SHARE DIVIDENDS[/h1]

If you bought a [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/]Shark Investor Pack[/url], now is the time to figure out how many Credits your Shares have produced!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/

After a complex calculation by the Imperial Bank, we have determined that every Share will receive a dividend of 202 Credits.


But as a celebration of the first Conquest, and because the lowered Credit gains have impacted the amount of total Credits spent, we have decided to double this amount. You have thus received 404 Credits per Share, which means [b]20,200 Credits for a 50 Share Investor Pack[/b].


Stay tuned for the next Conquest. Hopefully, with the increase of Credit gains brought by the new patch, dividends might rise even further!

Join the [url=https://discord.gg/JwTKNu5]Discord[/url] or the [url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/]forum[/url]. We are answering all your questions, and listening to all your suggestions for the future of the game!

notes.title: Update v0.31 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.31[/h1]

[u]Thursday, August 10, 2017[/u]

[h1]MAIN FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*][u]Gangs of Space[/u] is now available on [b]Steam Early Access[/b]!
[list]
[*]With a brand new title screen.[/*]
[*]3 new skins & titles that can be purchased in Early Access Packs.[/*]
[*]Foreword from the developers on first launch of the client.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]Changes to the [b]conquest system[/b]:
[list]
[*]Conquering each zone now gives [b]Credits[/b] instead of DNA (or Greed).[/*]
[*]Conquest is now the sole source of Credits (no more Credits on Greed level up or ship destruction).[/*]
[*]Greed level now affects [b]both conquest speed AND the number of Credits[/b] & Sector Points earned.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]New [b]tutorial system[/b] that forces you to do a few specific actions when you start the game.
[list]
[*]These tutorial tooltips can be completely disabled in the Settings.[/*]
[*][b]Tips[/b] about the game are also shown on warp screens.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]Redesigned [b]Gang interface[/b]:
[list]
[*]Gangs can be [b]created from within the game[/b].[/*]
[*]Gang members now have [b]ranks[/b]: Owner, Admin, or Member.[/*]
[*]New [b]invitation UI[/b] (both for inviter & invitee).[/*]
[*]Owner can now leave their Gang, and ownership will be automatically transfered to next highest ranking member.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Player resistance are now capped to 75% (down from 90%).[/*]
[*]When you loose a Greed level, you do not start at the beginning of the previous level, but at the end of it. The Greed depleting rate has been slightly increased. Overall, higher Greed levels are easier to obtain & sustain.[/*]
[*]Boss no longer spawn before T4.[/*]
[*]Common items drop less in high tier systems.[/*]
[*]The leveling from level 1 to level 10 is now smoother.[/*]
[*]Enemy group compositions have been re-balanced.[/*]
[*]Small zones now give a bit more Credits and Sector Points.[/*]
[*]Conquest scores now expire faster if you leave a Sector untouched (3 minutes, down from 1 hour).[/*]
[/list]
[h1]SMALL CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Warehouses can be renamed and re-ordered.[/*]
[*]Added an alternative basic skin for Gemeters and Astrolaxes, available to everyone.[/*]
[*]Skins no longer cost Credits to apply to your ships.[/*]
[*]Conquered maps now close after 5 minutes (down from 10 minutes).[/*]
[*]The Objective Tracker is now a little more readable.[/*]
[*]Gates are now oriented properly in the Motherbase.[/*]
[*]Tooltips are much more readable across the board.[/*]
[*]Multiple tiers can be deployed at the same time in the Navigation window.[/*]
[*]When you reach a certain power level, the game will suggest T4 (normal), T5 (hard) and T6 (very hard) systems instead of just suggesting T4.[/*]
[*]Added trophy titles from the previous conquests.[/*]
[*]Updated the player overlay to make the name & bars more readable.[/*]
[*]Updated the enemy gauge to make it more readable.[/*]
[*]Neutral Sectors (= conquered by the Empire) are now shown in blue, the same as Sectors conquered by a Gang.[/*]
[*]You can see other players’ item hauls.[/*]
[*]You can no longer move, jettison or destroy items during the Warp countdown.[/*]
[*]Support for multiple Motherbases (in case of high server load).[/*]
[/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the client freezing when joining some broken systems.[/*]
[*]Removed hidden Greed leveling in T1~T3 maps.[/*]
[*]Fixed the position where popup list open (ex: ship selector in Achievement Codex, resolution list in Settings…).[/*]
[*]Fixed many broken sprites all over the UI.[/*]
[*]Boss lifebars no longer block on the first bar.[/*]
[*]Player & enemies overlays stay in proper position when changing resolution.[/*]
[*]The client log should no longer grow to multiple GB.[/*]
[*]Fixed a slight jerkiness on the damage numbers’ movement.[/*]
[*]Conquest gauge no longer overlaps with the leveling choice window.[/*]
[*]Typing 1~5 in chat will no longer swap items when chatting with the Ship window open.[/*]
[*]Prevent multiple cases of disconnect with the message “ITEM OPERATION CANCELLED”.[/*]
[/list]
